```{r load_data}
library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)

# Load processed eBird breeding data
zf_breeding <- readRDS("data/ebird_breeding_raptors.rds")

# Load clean BBS trends
ohio_trends <- readRDS("data/bbs_trend_summary_clean.rds")

# Load BBS indices (for annual trajectory comparison)
bbs_indices <- readRDS("data/bbs_all_indices.rds")

```

```{r}
# figure out which name column ebird used
name_col <- if ("common_name" %in% names(zf_breeding)) {
  "common_name"
} else {
  "scientific_name"
}

# add year if not already there
if (!"year" %in% names(zf_breeding)) {
  zf_breeding <- zf_breeding %>%
    mutate(year = year(observation_date))
}

# reporting rate = detections / total checklists per species per year
ebird_annual <- zf_breeding %>%
  rename(species_name = !!sym(name_col)) %>%
  group_by(year, species_name) %>%
  summarise(
    total_checklists = n(),
    detections       = sum(species_observed, na.rm = TRUE),
    reporting_rate   = detections / total_checklists,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# quick summary to check
ebird_annual %>%
  group_by(species_name) %>%
  summarise(
    years           = n(),
    mean_rate       = round(mean(reporting_rate) * 100, 2),
    mean_checklists = round(mean(total_checklists), 0),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(mean_rate))
```

```{r}
# bbs and ebird use slightly different names so need a cross check
ebird_names <- sort(unique(ebird_annual$species_name))
bbs_names   <- sort(unique(ohio_trends$species))

# clean both to a common format before matching
clean_name <- function(x) {
  x <- tolower(x)                   #lowercase everyname
  x <- gsub("[[:punct:]]", "", x)  
  x <- gsub("\\s+", "", x)           # remove all spaces
  x <- gsub("allforms", "", x)  # bbs appends "(all forms)" for some species
  x <- gsub("^american", "", x) # ebird keeps "american" prefix, bbs doesnt always
  x
}

ebird_lookup <- data.frame(ebird_name = ebird_names) %>%
  mutate(clean = clean_name(ebird_name))

bbs_lookup <- data.frame(bbs_name = bbs_names) %>%
  mutate(clean = clean_name(bbs_name))

crosswalk <- inner_join(ebird_lookup, bbs_lookup, by = "clean")
crosswalk %>% select(ebird_name, bbs_name)
```

```{r}
bbs_annual <- list()

for (sp_name in names(bbs_indices)) {
  idx <- bbs_indices[[sp_name]]
  
  # bbsBayes2 stores indices differently depending on version so try a few approaches . idx is raw datav for each species
  idx_df <- tryCatch({
    if (is.data.frame(idx)) {
      idx
    } else if ("data_summary" %in% names(idx)) {
      as.data.frame(idx$data_summary)
    } else if ("indices" %in% names(idx)) {
      as.data.frame(idx$indices)
    } else {
      as.data.frame(idx)
    }
  }, error = function(e) NULL)
  
  if (is.null(idx_df) || nrow(idx_df) == 0) next #skip to next species
  
  # find year column - look for values in a plausible year range
  year_col <- names(idx_df)[sapply(idx_df, function(x) {
    is.numeric(x) && any(x >= 1966 & x <= 2025, na.rm = TRUE)
  })][1]
  
  # find index column by common name patterns
  index_col <- names(idx_df)[grepl("index|median|mean|estimate",
                                    tolower(names(idx_df)))][1]
  
  if (is.na(year_col)) year_col <- "year"
  if (is.na(index_col)) {
    num_cols  <- names(idx_df)[sapply(idx_df, is.numeric)]
    index_col <- num_cols[num_cols != year_col][1]
  }
  
  if (!is.na(year_col) && !is.na(index_col)) {
    bbs_annual[[sp_name]] <- data.frame(
      bbs_name  = sp_name,
      year      = as.numeric(idx_df[[year_col]]),
      bbs_index = as.numeric(idx_df[[index_col]])
    ) %>%
      group_by(bbs_name, year) %>%
      summarise(bbs_index = mean(bbs_index, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
  }
}

bbs_annual_df <- bind_rows(bbs_annual)
head(bbs_annual_df)
```

```{r}
# load trend summary
trend_summary <- readRDS("data/bbs_trend_summary_full.rds")


# add cleaned names for joining
bbs_annual_df <- bbs_annual_df %>% mutate(clean = clean_name(bbs_name))
ebird_annual  <- ebird_annual  %>% mutate(clean = clean_name(species_name))

# only keep species with enough ohio routes - otherwise bbs estimate is driven by out-of-state strata not ohio itself.
ohio_coverage <- trend_summary %>%
  filter(region_type == "stratum",
         grepl("^US-OH", region),
         period == "2000-2024") %>%
  group_by(species) %>%
  summarise(
    n_ohio_strata     = n(),
    total_ohio_routes = sum(n_routes, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
#keep only well-covered species
ohio_validated_species <- ohio_coverage %>%
  filter(total_ohio_routes >= 5) %>%
  pull(species)

# apply filter
bbs_annual_df <- bbs_annual_df %>%
  filter(bbs_name %in% ohio_validated_species)

head(ohio_coverage)
```
```{r}
# join on cleaned name and year, overlap period only
combined <- inner_join(
  bbs_annual_df %>% filter(year >= 2005, year <= 2024),
  ebird_annual  %>% filter(year >= 2005, year <= 2024),
  by = c("clean", "year")
)

# pearson correlation and trend direction per species
correlation_results <- combined %>%
  group_by(bbs_name) %>%
  summarise(
    overlap_years   = n(),
    correlation     = if (sum(complete.cases(bbs_index, reporting_rate)) >= 5) {
      cor(bbs_index, reporting_rate, use = "complete.obs")
    } else {
      NA_real_
    },
    bbs_direction   = ifelse(coef(lm(scale(bbs_index)     ~ year))[2] > 0, "Increasing", "Declining"),
    ebird_direction = ifelse(coef(lm(scale(reporting_rate) ~ year))[2] > 0, "Increasing", "Declining"),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    direction_agrees = bbs_direction == ebird_direction,
    correlation      = round(correlation, 3),
    agreement        = case_when(
      is.na(correlation)       ~ "Insufficient data",
      correlation >  0.7       ~ "Strong agreement",
      correlation >  0.4       ~ "Moderate agreement",
      correlation >  0         ~ "Weak agreement",
      TRUE                     ~ "Disagreement"
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(correlation))

write.csv(correlation_results, "data/cross_validation_results.csv", row.names = FALSE)
head(correlation_results)
```


```{r}
correlation_results %>%
  filter(!is.na(correlation)) %>%
  arrange(desc(correlation)) %>%
  select(Species = bbs_name, r = correlation, 
         Direction = direction_agrees, Agreement = agreement) %>%
  mutate(Direction = ifelse(Direction, "Yes", "No")) %>%
  print(n = Inf)
```
